proposed_widenings.name: operated_vehicle
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core mechanic is a persistent vehicle/object with its own stats, crew compartment, mutable lever-controlled state, and repeatable Utilize-driven operations. That does not fit passive, activation, triggered_reaction, spawned_creature, or composite magic-item families without lying about resource use or ownership.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature in the compartment can take a Utilize action to move as many as two of the apparatus's levers up or down. After each use, a lever goes back to its neutral position.

proposed_widenings.name: magic_item mechanics family for repeatable non-resource operation
proposed_widenings.justification: Current magic-item activations require a resource and reset cadence. This vehicle is operated repeatedly via actions with no daily charge pool or use-count.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature in the compartment can take a Utilize action to move as many as two of the apparatus's levers up or down.

proposed_widenings.name: vehicle_or_object_stat_block
proposed_widenings.justification: The item has durable object/vehicle combat stats and environment rules, not a creature stat block or passive grant list.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The Apparatus of the Crab is a Large object with the following statistics: AC 20; HP 200; Speed 30 ft., Swim 30 ft. (or 0 ft. if the legs aren't extended); Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage.

notes: Not DM-agenda. The rules are deterministic, but the current authored surface has no honest way to model a crewed vehicle with lever-state, hatch/window/claw state transitions, vehicle movement/rotation, sealed-compartment air tracking, or depth-pressure damage.
